Album.name: get-albums-async
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an IEnumerable of all Albums, with each Album depicted as AlbumDto.

Album.name: get-album-ids-async
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an IEnumerable containing the primary key Album.Id values for every Album.

Album.name: get-albums-count-async
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the total number of Albums.

Album.name: get-album-by-id-async
Album.param: The value of the primary key Album.Id for the Album to be found.
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the Album of depicted as AlbumDto on success, and null on failure.

Album.name: save-album-async
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an AlbumDto depicting the saved Album on success.

Album.name: delete-album-by-id-async
Album.summary: Deletes the Album, and upon completion: ensures that contiguous Album.Order sequencing beginning at first index of the Navbar ordering is maintained, along with the relative Ordering prior to deletion. Performs operations to maintain these properties where necessary.
Album.param: The value of the primary key Album.Id for the Album to be deleted.
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains true on success and false on not found.

Album.name: get-published-albums-async
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an IEnumerable of all Albums where Album.Published, depicting each as AlbumDto.

Album.name: set-layout-preset-async
Album.param: The value of the primary key Album.Id of the Album to be modified.
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the Album depicted as AlbumDto on success and null on not found.

Album.name: assign-album-in-nav-async
Album.summary: Includes the Album in the Navbar if is positive and adheres to the bounds constraint of the database, the Album is Published, and the Navbar is not full. Give preference to assigning Album.Order to , but include Album in Navbar even where is occupied if above conditions are met.

Album.name: get-nav-included-albums-async
Album.summary: Retrieves all Albums that are included in the Navbar (strictly), ordered by Album.Order (ascending).

AlbumItem.name: save-photo-display-async
AlbumItem.summary: Inserts new AlbumItem of child class PhotoDisplay, initialized at root level of Album with highest AlbumItem.Order among all root level AlbumItems of Album.
AlbumItem.remarks: An AlbumItem which belongs to no Collection (that is, AlbumItem.CollectionId == null) is considered to be at root level of Album.
AlbumItem.param: The primary key of the Album to save new AlbumItem to.
The primary key of the Photo to associate with this PhotoDisplay.
Optionally may pass CancellationToken. If none specified, uses default.
AlbumItem.returns: true on success and false on cases of failures not resulting in an Exception being thrown.
AlbumItem.exception: May be propagated when upon encountering DbUpdateException while attempting Database insertion.
